Research & Vision

What problem are we solving?

Diabetes care is a lifelong process, yet many patients experience it as a sequence of isolated clinic visits. Between consultations, monitoring, follow-ups, nutrition counselling, lifestyle changes and patient education can lose momentum. Patients may disengage because of work constraints, financial pressure, digital barriers, caregiver dependence, stigma or diabetes-related fatigue.

What we are building

Sugar Coat is a multilingual AI platform concept designed to make diabetes care easier to understand, access and sustain between clinic visits. It brings together supportive AI care, consent-based care connections, a secure care passport, a non-clinical clinic intelligence layer, and trusted community education and rewards.

Patient information

Frequently asked questions

Helpful answers about consultation with Dr. Susheel Tyagi.

Which health concerns can I discuss during a consultation?

Consultation areas include type 1 and type 2 diabetes, hypertension, obesity, metabolic health and adult internal medicine. The doctor will advise whether your concern is within the scope of the clinic.

Where is Mediix Clinic located?

Mediix Clinic is at 14/3, Niti Khand-2, Indirapuram, near Swarn Jayanti Park, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201014.

What should I bring to my first appointment?

Bring previous medical reports, a list of current medicines, relevant prescriptions and any home blood-glucose or blood-pressure readings.

How can I request an appointment?

Use the Book Appointment option on this website, or contact the clinic by phone or WhatsApp to enquire about an appointment.

About Dr. Susheel Tyagi

Internal Medicine, patient awareness and continuity of care.

Dr. Susheel Tyagi is a physician in Internal Medicine with a medical background from King George’s Medical University (KGMU). His professional interests span diabetes, hypertension, obesity, infectious diseases and metabolic disorders.

His approach centres on understanding the individual behind the condition through careful evaluation, informed clinical decisions, patient awareness and continuity of care.
